name: The Eco of Tammy's Ghost
source:
A short horror Visual Novel about a girl that goes missing and months later is found by the local gardener Jack.
Whether the girl was kidnapped or just got lost in the woods is unknown.

[From [url=https://intstories.itch.io/the-eco-of-tammys-ghost]Itch.io[/url]]

This visual novel was inspired by the webnovel "Sister Sister" from the Reddit author whoeverfightsmonster.
translation:
一部关于一个女孩失踪的短篇恐怖视觉小说，几个月后被当地园丁杰克发现。
目前尚不清楚这名女孩是被绑架还是在树林里迷路了。

[来自[url=https://intstories.itch.io/the-eco-of-tammys-ghost]Itch.io[/url]]

这部视觉小说的灵感来自Reddit作者whoeverfightsmonster的网络小说《姐姐姐姐》。
